summary: Today's briefing highlights significant legal rulings and regulatory updates impacting the retail sector, alongside notable developments in the Reliance IPO landscape.

bullets.text: The Supreme Court issued rulings on river pollution and mental cruelty in its latest SCC volume.
The government extended the aluminium can certification deadline to April 2027, benefiting beverage manufacturers.
Titan's luxury brand Zoya aims for ₹500 crore revenue by FY27, capitalizing on high-end jewellery demand.
Mukesh Ambani's Jio IPO attracted record bids of $77 billion, marking a significant milestone in Indian capital markets.
D2C brands in India target over 30% festive growth despite a 20% rise in acquisition costs.
